title: Refactoring UI - Content
text: Hey everyone, in this video we're going to be taking a look at a text heavy UI. Now the primary goal of this video will be to help you make better decisions with page hierarchy, formatting, and layout when working with text. And for this example, we're going to be taking a look at this high page for a fictional conference called FutureWeb. It's a conference that explores the latest tools in technology in web development. Before we get into it, let's just break this page down a bit. Now there's nothing special here.
zh: 大家好，在本期视频中，我们将重点探讨一个以文本为主的 UI。本期视频的主要目标是帮助你们在处理文本时，更好地进行页面层级、格式和布局的决策。在本例中，我们将分析一个虚构会议“FutureWeb”的高保真页面。这个会议旨在探索 Web 开发领域的最新技术工具。在开始之前，我们先简单拆解一下这个页面。其实，这里并没有什么特别之处。
